summary: SD-31 wave 17 equipment_modifier lane: largest remaining in-progress driver is the Intelligent Item own-stat-block VAR family, no wired consumer exists at all
tracked_at: docs/release/SD-31-corpus-closure-grind/artifacts/OPEN-ISSUES.md (not yet filed as a row -- filed only in the retro log by this cycle)
what: 172 of equipment_modifier's 576 remaining in-progress units (core_rulebook 88, mythic_adventures 84) carry a real BONUS:VAR|IntItemStat<ABL>/IntelligentItemEgo/IntItemAlignment/IntItemSenseRange chain family -- an intelligent magic item's OWN ability-score/ego/alignment/sense-range stat block (the item's personality/possession-check stats, e.g. core_rulebook:equipment_modifier:intelligent_item_ability_score_charisma_14's BONUS:VAR|IntItemStatCHA|4), not a wearer-facing bonus. None of arms_armor.rs/general.rs/magic_items.rs/equipmods.rs read a VAR chain at all (they read COMBAT|AC, SKILL, STAT, WEAPON respectively), and no app surface (grep -rln 'Intelligent Item' apps/desktop/src returns nothing beyond catalog/data plumbing) renders an intelligent item's own stat block, so there is no wired consumer this cycle's grounding probe could observe a delta on even if a fifth equipment_effects resolver were added -- DoD-8 would be unmet (no real driver reads it on screen).
